note:
DEPTH PASS (the base console is merged). Goal: turn this service's sub-sections and config sections into REAL backend integrations. For EACH capability entry listed in `depth_targets` decide:
  BUILD — Vyomi can model it in the shared core (state + native API semantics): implement it in core/<svc>_core.py (and the offline route if offline lacks it), add conformance checks in tests/conformance/, raise the entry's level in core/capabilities/<cloud>/<svc>.json (not_simulated→limited/full, config_only→limited/full where now ENFORCED, limited→full where a limitation is removed), wire the console section to it with a UI↔native-API round trip in consoles/tests/smoke-<cloud>.mjs and a "live" fixture for any list/detail page.

Real coverage must go UP; nothing may regress: fidelity ≥ 90%, every capability claim true on nano AND offline, smokes green. Do not edit consoles/honest-allowlist.json or .github/.
House rules: keep consoles/src/<cloud>/kit/Capability.jsx as on base (add JSON imports only), list the service ONCE in registry.js, register any NEW core in wasm/build_cores.py + wasm/nano-boot.js (own line, never inside a // comment) + core/nano_registry.py + core/nano_persist.py (tests/conformance/test_nano_core_manifest.py), unique variable names in the smoke files, 'Vyomi' as plain text, re-vendor with python3 wasm/build_cores.py, rebuild bundles, COMMIT your source.

depth_targets.title: Topic labels, message retention and CMEK
limitations: Labels and messageRetentionDuration are stored and returned exactly as configured.

kmsKeyName is stored and returned, but Vyomi does not call Cloud KMS to encrypt/decrypt message data — there is no real encryption-at-rest difference between a Google-managed key and a customer-managed one in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Attach a schema to a topic
limitations: schemaSettings (schema name + encoding) is stored on the topic and returned as configured.
Published messages are never validated against the schema — a payload that violates the schema still publishes successfully.

depth_targets.title: Push delivery config
limitations: pushConfig.pushEndpoint is stored and returned exactly as configured.
Vyomi never makes the outbound HTTP call — a push subscriber is not actually invoked. Use Pull delivery to receive messages in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Message ordering and exactly-once delivery flags
limitations: enableMessageOrdering and enableExactlyOnceDelivery are stored and returned as configured.
Vyomi does not enforce per-key ordering or deduplicate redelivered messages — a subscriber may still see messages out of order or more than once.

depth_targets.title: Retry policy (immediate vs. exponential backoff)
limitations: retryPolicy is stored and returned as configured; Vyomi redelivers on the next pull after the ack deadline regardless of the configured backoff timing.

depth_targets.title: Subscription message filter
limitations: Pub/Sub's filter expression language isn't implemented — every message is delivered to every subscription on its topic regardless of attributes.

depth_targets.title: Write to BigQuery / write to Cloud Storage delivery
limitations: BigQuery and Cloud Storage aren't Vyomi products yet, so there is nowhere for this delivery type to write. Choose Pull or Push instead.

depth_targets.title: Topic ingestion from external sources (AWS/Azure/Kafka/CDC)
limitations: Vyomi has no connectors to AWS, Azure, Kafka or database CDC sources, so a topic can't be configured to ingest from them.

depth_targets.title: Message transforms (JavaScript UDFs on publish)
limitations: Vyomi does not run a JavaScript transform pipeline on published messages.

depth_targets.title: Topic / subscription metrics and monitoring charts
limitations: Vyomi does not collect the time-series metrics (throughput, backlog, oldest unacked age) the console's Metrics tab charts.
